findings.evidence: grep: Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:52,64,68,91,96. Roadmap Diffraction/README.md:177-179 and :350 list `QFT.Scattering.DIS.Exclusive.Kinematics.Basic` as supplying the identified-hadron momentum transfer `t`, "which diffraction reuses rather than re-deriving". `grep -r ExclKinematics EpsilonEridani/` shows no bridge or other consumer exists.
findings.fix: Reuse the exclusive momentum-transfer layer instead of re-deriving it: either carry the diffractive variables on `ExclKinematics` with `qPrime := p_X` (where `hMomentum` is exactly `p_add_q_eq_pPrime_add_pX` and `t` is `ExclKinematics.tMom`), or, if `DisKinematics` must stay the carrier for `xBj`/`W2`, add a conversion `toExcl (K : DisKinematics V) (phiL phiH : ℝ) : ExclKinematics V` with `qPrime := pX K`, define `tMom`/`delta` through it, and obtain `tMom_eq_pPrime_sub_p_sq` from `ExclKinematics.tMom_eq_hadronic_transfer_sq` rather than a fresh proof.
findings.issue: `delta K = K.p - K.pPrime` (line 63), `tMom g K = g Δ Δ` (line 78), `pX K = K.q + delta K` (line 71), `p_add_q_eq_pPrime_add_pX` (line 110) and `tMom_eq_pPrime_sub_p_sq` (line 115) restate, on a second record and with Δ's sign flipped, API that already exists: `ExclKinematics.delta := pPrime - p` (Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:64), `ExclKinematics.tMom := g delta delta` (:68, same real number since `g (-x) (-x) = g x x`), the field `hMomentum : p + q = pPrime + qPrime` (:52) with `delta_eq_q_sub_qPrime : delta = q - qPrime` (:91) — i.e. `qPrime` *is* `pX` — and `tMom_eq_hadronic_transfer_sq` (:96), which is the same statement proved there by `rfl`. The new file does not even import that module, so the two `t`'s and two `Δ`'s are unrelated declarations in the same `DIS` namespace tree with opposite conventions.

findings.evidence: DIS/Kinematics/Basic.lean:79-95 `W2_expand : K.W2 g = g K.p K.p + 2 * g K.p K.q + g K.q K.q`, proof identical in shape to lines 122-125 and 138-142 of the new file; Mathlib has no generic lemma for this (grep of Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm and QuadraticForm found only `neg_left`, `sub_left`, `polar_*`).
findings.fix: Add one lemma in `DIS.Kinematics`, e.g. `lemma apply_add_self (g : Bilin V) (hg : g.IsSymm) (a b : V) : g (a + b) (a + b) = g a a + 2 * g a b + g b b`, reprove `W2_expand` from it, and use it (with `b := -b` or via `sub_left`/`sub_right`) for `MX2_eq` and `MY2_eq`.
findings.issue: `MX2_eq` (line 120) and `MY2_eq` (line 134) each re-derive the symmetric-bilinear square expansion `g (a ± b) (a ± b) = g a a ± 2 g a b + g b b` inline (`simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; rw [hg.eq ..]; ring`), which is the same algebra already carried out in `DisKinematics.W2_expand` (DIS/Kinematics/Basic.lean:79-95). That makes three copies of the same expansion in the DIS kinematics layer, and §0.2 will need a fourth.

summary: The diffractive momentum-transfer API (`delta`, `tMom`, `pX`, momentum conservation, `tMom_eq_pPrime_sub_p_sq`) is a second, sign-flipped copy of `Exclusive.Kinematics.ExclKinematics.delta`/`tMom`/`qPrime`/`hMomentum`/`tMom_eq_hadronic_transfer_sq`, with no bridge between them, although the roadmap names that module as the one diffraction "reuses rather than re-deriving"; and the quadratic expansions in `MX2_eq`/`MY2_eq` re-derive what `DisKinematics.W2_expand` already does.
